target.value: any number of creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

save.description: Will disbelief, then Fortitude partial — see description

description.summary: This spell functions like Phantasmal Killer , except it can affect more than one creature
description.value: This spell functions like Phantasmal Killer , except it can affect more than one creature. Only the affected creatures see the phantasmal creatures attacking them, though you see the attackers as shadowy shapes. If a subject’s Fortitude save succeeds, it still takes 3d6 points of non-elemental damage and is stunned for 1 round. The subject also takes 1d4 points of Strength damage.
